r0_observed: Current canonical JSPACE_GWT_BOOT_BINDING_RECEIPT/v1 at base main validates a source-lock object but accepts both BUNDLED_MANIFEST.json and SOURCE_LOCK.json as caller-selected CLI paths.
The source-lock authority check at base main is a field comparison against the string repository_source_tree; caller-controlled bytes can reproduce that string.

Therefore a caller can supply a mutually self-consistent alternate manifest and alternate lock and still satisfy the intended external-anchor shape unless the validator itself chooses the repository-owned path.
The base-main source lock does not bind bundled_core.runtime_sha256 and the boot receipt does not explicitly fence local-latent cognition mode.
r1_infer: A trust anchor is external only if its bytes/location are selected by the trusted validator/repository, not by the untrusted observed receipt caller.

add a second validator around the existing validator

r3_counter: Caller-selected paths might be harmless if runtime invocation is always trusted, but the boot gate is specifically meant to prevent the observed runtime from authoring its own expected identity, so the invocation boundary itself must fail closed.
